label: Bible Study
prompt: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his _____ over me was love.
verse: He brought me to the banqueting house, and his banner over me was love.
note: The banqueting house verse — a favorite Sunday school chorus with a love banner flying high.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the _____ through our Lord Jesus Christ.
verse: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
note: The end of Paul's great resurrection chapter: death has lost its sting, so it ends with a thank-you.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And at _____ Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
verse: And at midnight Paul and Silas prayed, and sang praises unto God: and the prisoners heard them.
note: Beaten and locked in stocks, Paul and Silas held a midnight hymn sing — and the other prisoners were listening.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou art of _____ eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
verse: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil, and canst not look on iniquity: wherefore lookest thou upon them that deal treacherously, and holdest thy tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he?
note: Habakkuk's honest complaint: if God can't bear to look on evil, why let wicked Babylon swallow people better than itself?

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and _____ with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
verse: He is despised and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and we hid as it were our faces from him; he was despised, and we esteemed him not.
note: 'A man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief' — the line Handel set in Messiah's aria 'He was despised.'
